rate_confidence.obbba_90pct_cap: unverified: assumed NOT to apply to CFTC event contracts, which is why exchange legs net
rate_confidence.depth_units: unverified: Kalshi size_fp is read as contracts
rate_confidence.not_modelled: section 1256 year-end mark-to-market and the straddle rules, which can tax the winning leg in one year while deferring the losing leg

venues.name: Kalshi
venues.notes: CFTC-regulated DCM. Taker ceil(0.07*C*P*(1-P)); most sports series are maker-free. Verify the live schedule before sizing.

venues.name: Polymarket
venues.notes: CLOB, USDC-settled. No trading fee on the book historically; real cost is the on/off ramp and gas. Oracle resolution, not league-official -- read the resolution text per market.
